title: Finite-Depth Channel Classification of Mixed-State Topological Order
exact_target: Decide which mixed topological states can be connected by finite-depth local channels and characterize their anyonic obstructions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006637 (OWR-14299913-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Higher Structures from Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory (2026), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2026/12, pp. 737--794. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The permitted ancillary systems and direction of channel conversion must be fixed. One-way conversion is not automatically an equivalence relation.
